name: aggregate_assessments
description: Count RFFF proposals grouped by one or more fields, with optional filters — rollups without hauling rows into context. Use it whenever the question asks 'how many' or wants a breakdown; do NOT fetch rows with search_proposals just to count them. Counting semantics: counts DISTINCT proposals. Person-level filters (factor1..factor4_assessment, person_overall_assessment) mean 'the proposal has at least one person matching'. Grouping by a person-level field counts a proposal once per distinct value present among its personnel, so buckets can overlap and may sum to more than the proposal total; meta.overlapping_buckets flags this. Buckets reflect observed values verbatim — e.g. 'Complete' and 'Implemented' appear as separate buckets; never merge or guess-normalize them. Allowed group_by fields: fiscal_year, reviewing_component, reviewing_subcomponent, assessment_state, mitigation_status, award_state, factor1_assessment, factor2_assessment, factor3_assessment, factor4_assessment, person_overall_assessment (membership checked at runtime; the contract stays structural).

group_by.description: One or more field names to group by, from the allowed set listed in the tool description. Runtime-validated; unknown fields are invalid_args.

filters.description: Same exact-match filters as search_proposals, ANDed together. Every field is enum-ish: allowed values are the OBSERVED sets profiled from rfff_seed (x-enum-source: observed_enums), regenerated on every seed run and rendered into this description at runtime — deliberately not enumerated in this frozen structural contract.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

reviewing_component.description: Reviewing component. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

reviewing_subcomponent.description: Reviewing subcomponent. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

assessment_state.description: Assessment state. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

mitigation_status.description: Mitigation status on the proposal. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

award_state.description: Award state. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

award_type.description: Award type. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

review_type.description: Assessment/review type. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

factor1_assessment.description: Factor 1 (FTRP), person-level: at least one matching person. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

factor2_assessment.description: Factor 2 (Funding), person-level: at least one matching person. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

factor3_assessment.description: Factor 3 (Patents), person-level: at least one matching person. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

factor4_assessment.description: Factor 4 (Entity Lists), person-level: at least one matching person. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

person_overall_assessment.description: Opaque overall personnel assessment (person-level). Exact match only. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

data.description: One bucket per distinct combination of group_by values.

group.description: Map of group_by field name to its observed value for this bucket.

total.description: Total buckets before the row cap.

overlapping_buckets.description: True when any group_by field is person-level, so a proposal can appear in multiple buckets and bucket counts may sum to more than the proposal total.
